news.headline: FLOOD WATCH — NWS Melbourne: Flood Watch for Orange, Osceola, Seminole, Volusia, Brevard & most of east-central Florida through Fri Nov 20 7 PM — 3–6 in. of rain, isolated 8–12 in.; Flood Warning continues for St. Johns River near Cocoa at major flood stage — 17.2 ft Wed 8:15 AM (flood stage 16 ft), forecast 17.4 ft by Sat, approaching the flood of record; moderate flash-flood risk Wed–Fri, high surf / rip-current risk through Friday

U.S. housing starts rose 9.9% in October to 1.309 million annual rate, beating forecasts — single-family starts up 4.0% to 864,000, completions up 6.5% to 1.272 million — but building permits plunged 7.4% to 1.295 million, lowest since May 2020, with single-family permits down 8.7% to 772,000
Builder confidence fell 4 points to 25 in November — lowest since April 2012 — NAHB/Wells Fargo HMI; 46% of builders cut prices (post-Covid high), 68% offered incentives, buyer traffic fell to 16

Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31 — permit application date governs which edition applies; Miami-Dade portal cutoff is 4 PM Dec 30, with new flood documentation and coastal corrosion rules

Copper tumbled below $13,000 Wed — LME 3-month fell 5.4% in midmorning U.S. trading to $12,505.50/ton, lowest since April, amid strong dollar, China demand concerns and AI-stock selloff; North American clean copper scrap fell another 2¢/lb Tue
Leap Partners acquires Crowther Heating & Air Conditioning in Kilmarnock, VA — its second Virginia acquisition in two months; 37 HVAC, plumbing and electrical companies acquired in four years

Fed minutes out Wed afternoon read hawkish — FOMC participants considered larger rate hikes if inflation worsens, with Board member Waller calling for a 50 bp move; October meeting held funds at 3.75–4.00%, markets price ~95% chance of a Dec hike; Nvidia's $115.8B revenue beat faded as stocks stayed lower Wed
Florida workers' comp: Commissioner Yaworsky approved NCCI's −7.4% average rate cut for new and renewal policies from Jan 1, 2027 — 11th straight year of reductions

NBA: Heat (8-6, 5 straight wins) host 1-13 Milwaukee Bucks tonight Wed 7 PM ET on ESPN at Kaseya Center — Giannis faces his former team for the first time on Vice City Night; last out Mon — Magic 115, Celtics 105 (Bane 24 pts, Orlando's 4th straight win) · Heat 128, Rockets 110
NFL Week 11 Sun Nov 22 — all Florida teams on the road: Dolphins at Bills 1 PM ET, Buccaneers at Lions 1 PM ET, Jaguars at Giants 4:25 PM ET
